FIELDS.NAME: Heritage Upholstery Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Heritage Upholstery Services, we specialize in high-quality upholstery services for both residential and commercial clients. Our operations encompass a wide range of services including reupholstering furniture, repairing cushions, and customizing interior decor. We pride ourselves on using only industry-standard equipment and materials to ensure the highest level of workmanship and client satisfaction. 

Our skilled staff is trained in upholstery techniques, focusing on fabric handling, cleaning, and repair practices, which minimizes the risk of errors and accidents. In addition, we maintain documented safety protocols for the safe handling of chemicals and machinery, thereby promoting a safe work environment. 

For our mobile upholstery services, we carry comprehensive commercial auto insurance to protect against risks associated with on-site operations. Regular audits of our safety and quality control measures are conducted to ensure ongoing compliance with industry standards, and we encourage customer feedback to continuously improve our services. By adhering to these practices, Heritage Upholstery Services is committed to providing exceptional quality and safety in all our operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 09/15/2022, a customer reported damage to a chair that had been reupholstered due to a manufacturing defect in the foam cushioning, amounting to $1,000. The claim was processed, and the chair was repaired at no cost to the customer, maintaining a positive service relationship. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Closed Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Grade 1 Safe, UL certified, fire-resistant with tamper-proof locking mechanism.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: "Security alarm system monitored by a central station and staff trained in emergency response procedures."
